placement.method: Fifteen surveyed wall segments ray-fitted in local east/north/up metres. Detail planes sit 0.16 m outside the original walls. Low, middle and high samples constrain width and height to original triangle surfaces. Source building vertices and packaged tile files are unchanged.
placement.sourceFitResidualMeters: under 0.008 for automatically fitted planes; corner also checked against the original mesh

approximations: This is reference-guided authored architectural detail, not photogrammetry or a current signage survey.
The 11 Times Square source model has a chamfered podium corner; bands follow that real silhouette instead of introducing a replacement rounded building.
Storefront dimensions, canopy structure, light placement, material patterns and curb furniture are visual interpretations.
Existing fictional movie, food and retail atlases supply 12 advertising panels. No current showtimes, ticket offers or live advertising are represented.
Door banks are closed exteriors; interiors are not built.
verification: Source-wall fit at full height, arrow walking and Shift running in both directions along sidewalks/street, clear visit starts, entry approaches, closed doors and solid barriers, actual Cesium Material/Primitive construction, native Canvas sign drawing and production build. Browser/WebGL visual verification and live FPS measurement unavailable.
